description: Safety layer: security, lifecycle, coordination, integration
instructions:
Agent Instructions for agent-b:

1. Read ProofWorkSpec.md for the full proof spec
2. Your waves: IX, X, XI, XII
3. Implement proofs in existing files (no new files)
4. Compile with: lean file.lean 2>&1
5. When done, encrypt results and POST to:
   POST https://kant-zk-relay.jmikedupont2.workers.dev/room/7ace57627265db88
   Content-Type: application/json
   Body: {"encrypted":"<base64(ciphertext)>","iv":"<hex 12 bytes>","tag":"<hex 16 bytes>","agent":"agent-b","task":"<task_id>","ts":"<iso8601>"}

Encryption (AES-256-GCM):
  Algorithm: AES-256-GCM (from cryptography library)
  Key: SHA256("{task_id}:twin-proof-wave-vi-xii-2026-09-17-mike")
  IV: 12 random bytes
  Encrypt: ct_with_tag = AESGCM(key).encrypt(iv, plaintext.encode(), None)
  Split: ciphertext = ct_with_tag[:-16], tag = ct_with_tag[-16:]
  Send ciphertext base64-encoded, iv and tag as hex

Result JSON (plaintext before encryption):
  {
    "compiled": true/false,
    "theorems_proved": N,
    "sorrys_remaining": N,
    "warnings": 0,
    "files_changed": ["File1.lean", ...],
    "theorems_added": ["theorem_name", ...],
    "total_theorems": N,
    "total_sorrys": N,
    "log": "compiler output"
  }

If compilation fails, set "compiled": false and include "error" + "log".
Max 3 attempts per wave.

Decryption (for orchestrator):
  key = SHA256(task_id + ":" + shared_salt)
  ct_with_tag = base64_decode(encrypted) + hex_decode(tag)
  plaintext = AESGCM(key).decrypt(hex_decode(iv), ct_with_tag, None)
